messages.content: 計算樣本平均值為98.2、標準差為1.4、樣本大小為40的零假設檢定的標準差，以得到人口平均值為98.6。

function.name: statistics_calculate_p_value
function.description: Calculate the p-value for a t-test on a single sample from a population. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

sample_mean.description: The mean of the sample data. This is a float type value.

population_mean.description: The mean of the population data. This is a float type value.

sample_std_dev.description: The standard deviation of the sample data. This is a float type value.

sample_size.description: The size of the sample data.

two_tailed.description: Whether the test is two-tailed. If not provided, default is true.

message.reasoning: The user says: "計算樣本平均值為98.2、標準差為1.4、樣本大小為40的零假設檢定的標準差，以得到人口平均值為98.6。" They want to calculate the standard deviation for a null hypothesis test? Actually they give sample mean 98.2, sample std dev 1.4, sample size 40, and population mean 98.6. They want to compute the p-value? The question: "計算樣本平均值為98.2、標準差為1.4、樣本大小為40的零假設檢定的標準差，以得到人口平均值為98.6。" The phrase "零假設檢定的標準差" might mean "standard deviation for the null hypothesis test"? But we already have sample std dev. Maybe they want to compute the standard error? Standard error = sample_std_dev / sqrt(sample_size) = 1.4 / sqrt(40). Let's compute: sqrt(40)=6.3249, so SE=1.4/6.3249=0.2213. Then t-statistic = (sample_mean - population_mean)/SE = (98.2-98.6)/0.2213 = -0.4/0.2213 = -1.807. Then p-value two-tailed: t(39 df). Let's compute approximate p-value. t=1.807, df=39. Using t distribution: p ~ 0.08? Let's approximate: For df=40, t=1.68 gives p=0.10, t=2.02 gives p=0.05. So t=1.807 gives p ~ 0.08. So p-value ~ 0.08. So answer: standard error 0.221, t-statistic -1.81, p-value ~0.08. Provide explanation. Use function? The tool calculates p-value. We can call it.
